title: Road Trips from Bengaluru: Coffee Hills, Coast and Weekend Drives
seoTitle: Road Trips from Bengaluru: Coffee Hills, Coast, Weekends | Kudozz Club
metaDescription: Road trips from Bengaluru: Nandi Hills, Mysuru, Coorg, Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Kabini, Ooty, Wayanad, Hampi, Gokarna and Goa, with distances and seasons.
description: A guide to road trips from Bengaluru: short drives to Nandi Hills, Mysuru and Srirangapatna, weekend trips to Coorg, Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Kabini, Wayanad, Ooty and Yercaud, and longer trips to Hampi, Gokarna, Goa and Pondicherry, with approximate distances, the Mysuru expressway, forest night bans, e-passes and seasons.
dek: Bengaluru is surrounded by road trips: coffee hills to the west, the Nilgiris to the south and the Deccan's ruins to the north.

hero.alt: The road up Nandi Hills near Bengaluru

intro: Bengaluru's weekend road trips fan out in every direction. The Mysuru expressway speeds the way south-west to Mysuru, Coorg, Kabini, Wayanad and Ooty; NH75 runs west to Hassan, Sakleshpur and Chikmagalur; NH48 heads north towards Hampi and Goa; and the Hosur road leads south-east to Yercaud and Pondicherry.
Two constraints shape many trips: the forest night bans through Bandipur, Nagarhole and Mudumalai, and e-pass rules for vehicles entering Ooty and Kodaikanal.
quickAnswer: The best road trips from Bengaluru are Nandi Hills (about 60 km), Mysuru (about 145 km), Coorg (about 260 km), Chikmagalur (about 245 km), Sakleshpur (about 220 km), Kabini (about 210 km), Wayanad (about 280 km), Ooty (about 270 km), Yercaud (about 230 km), Hampi (about 340 km), Gokarna (about 480 km) and Goa (about 560 to 600 km). October to March is best; the monsoon is lush in the hills.
takeaways: The Bengaluru–Mysuru expressway speeds trips to Mysuru, Coorg, Wayanad and Ooty.
Forest roads through Bandipur and Mudumalai close at night; time your drive.
Ooty needs an e-pass for outside vehicles.
Nandi Hills is a classic sunrise drive; arrive early.
Leave the city before 6 am to avoid traffic at the exits.

sections.heading: Tips for driving out of Bengaluru
list: Leave before 6 am; traffic at Electronic City, Tumakuru Road and the Mysuru Road exit builds quickly.
Two- and three-wheelers cannot use the Mysuru expressway's main carriageway.
Time forest crossings for daylight; check night-ban timings.
Apply for the Nilgiris e-pass before driving to Ooty.

sections.heading: Planning a long weekend
paras: With three days, combine two places on the same side of the city: Mysuru with Coorg, Chikmagalur with Sakleshpur or Belur and Halebidu, or Kabini with Wayanad. With four or five days, drive the Nilgiris loop through Mysuru, Ooty and Coonoor, or go north to Hampi and on to Badami.
On the road, stop for idli-vada and filter coffee at the old highway hotels, Maddur vadas on the Mysuru side, and benne dosa in Davanagere on the way north.

sections.heading: Coming back
list: Sunday evening traffic into the city is heavy on all exits; return early or on Monday.
If you are returning from Ooty or Wayanad, cross the forest before the night closure.
Keep the FASTag topped up; expressway tolls add up over a weekend.

sections.heading: When to go
paras: October to March is ideal, with cool mornings and clear skies. The monsoon (June to September) is beautiful in Coorg, Chikmagalur and Wayanad but brings heavy rain and some closures. April and May are hot on the plains and busy in the hills.

safety: Mountain roads close or slow down after heavy rain, snow or landslides; check road status and weather updates each morning and avoid driving after dark.
Permits, tolls, entry fees, pass openings and road works change; check official sources shortly before you travel.
Distances and driving times are approximate and vary with traffic, weather, road works and stops.
packing: Driving licence, RC, insurance and PUC certificate, with copies
Warm layers and a rain jacket
Cash for small towns and barriers

faqs.q: What are the best weekend road trips from Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Coorg, Chikmagalur, Sakleshpur, Kabini, Wayanad, Ooty and Mysuru.

faqs.q: Which hill station is closest to Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Nandi Hills for a morning; Sakleshpur and Chikmagalur for a weekend.

faqs.q: Can I drive through Bandipur at night?
faqs.a: No; the forest road closes to most traffic at night.

faqs.q: How far is Hampi from Bengaluru?
faqs.a: About 340 km, usually around six hours.

faqs.q: Do I need an e-pass for Ooty?
faqs.a: Yes, for vehicles from outside the Nilgiris district.

faqs.q: What is a good long road trip from Bengaluru?
faqs.a: Bengaluru to Goa via Hampi, or a loop through Coorg, Wayanad and Ooty.
